items.text: Sections consolidated & reordered — help topics are grouped into fewer, broader sections in a clearer order: Getting started, Configuring nextDash, Keyboard shortcuts, Search/commands/toolbar, Finders, Appearance & display, Organizing bookmarks, Pages/categories/bulk editing, Tags & collections, Inbox, Health & status, Data & backups, Self-hosting & troubleshooting.
Sticky accordion & scrollspy — Help now uses the same sticky quick links sidebar, single-open section accordion, and scroll-position highlighting as Config → General and Stats.

Animated Ko-fi button — the Support me on Ko-fi button now has the same twinkling-star glow as the What's New modal's donate CTA, centered on its own row; the jordibrw.nl link is larger and accent-themed.
Quick-link scroll offset — clicking a quick link could land partway into a section, hiding its title behind the sticky toolbar; jumps now always land on the section title.
Missing section borders — sections now get a dividing line between them, matching Help's bordered blocks, across Classic/Modern/Glass.

Split-shell divider now spans the full page — the vertical line between the quick-links sidebar and the content column used to stop wherever the sidebar's sticky box ended; it now runs the full height of the section content and meets the shell's bottom border on both Help and General.
